Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 98 now!
Synopsis :
Morale
Chandragupt apne sainikon ke sath khud ko chhipane ke lie dusri jagah ki or barhta hai. is bich, dhananand chanaky ke vaphadar sainikon ki prashansa karte hain, jab chak aur nishunbh ko unke samne pesh kiya jata hai, jinke pas yuddh kaushal men visheshagyata hai. raja unki pratibha se prabhavit hokar unhen apne vishesh balon men niyukt karta hai. chanaky ke utsahajnak shabd sabhi ko naitik rup se sakriy karte hain aur vah unhen magadh men pahchane jane se bachne ke lie apna vesh badalne ke lie kahte hain.
